description: Explain a cron expression in plain English, e.g. "0 9 * * 1-5" → "At 09:00, on Monday through Friday." Also returns notes on cron rules that often surprise people (day-of-month OR day-of-week, seconds field, shorthand expansion). Invalid expressions return isError with the reason. Read-only. Same engine as GET /api/explain.

expression.description: Cron expression, e.g. "0 9 * * 1-5", "*/15 * * * *", "0 30 8 * * *" (6 fields = leading seconds) or "@daily".

name: explain_cron
title: Explain a cron expression
